name: toolkit-mcp-server
description: Generate random IDs, QR codes, and hashes, encode and decode values, and geolocate IPs, plus gated network and system diagnostics, via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

TOOLKIT_ENABLE_NET_DIAGNOSTICS.title: Enable network diagnostics
TOOLKIT_ENABLE_NET_DIAGNOSTICS.description: Register the gated toolkit_check_network tool (ping/traceroute/connectivity/public_ip). Off by default — leave off for hosted/shared deployments.

TOOLKIT_ENABLE_SYSTEM_INFO.title: Enable system info
TOOLKIT_ENABLE_SYSTEM_INFO.description: Register the gated toolkit_check_system tool (host OS/CPU/memory/load/interfaces). Off by default — only meaningful on a local deployment.

TOOLKIT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK.title: Allow private network targets
TOOLKIT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK.description: With network diagnostics enabled, permit private/reserved/loopback targets. The second explicit gate; off by default blocks the cloud-metadata endpoint and internal recon.

TOOLKIT_GEO_API_KEY.title: Geolocation API key
TOOLKIT_GEO_API_KEY.description: API key for the geolocation endpoint, if it requires one. The default ip-api tier is keyless.

TOOLKIT_GEO_BASE_URL.title: Geolocation base URL
TOOLKIT_GEO_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for an ip-api-compatible geolocation endpoint. Default is the keyless ip-api endpoint, which is plaintext HTTP.

TOOLKIT_GEO_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS.title: Geolocation cache TTL (seconds)
TOOLKIT_GEO_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS.description: How long to cache geolocation results in memory. Geolocation is stable, so repeats are cached.

TOOLKIT_GEO_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN.title: Geolocation rate limit (per minute)
TOOLKIT_GEO_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN.description: Max geolocation requests per minute; excess requests are rejected with a retryable rate-limit error. Default 45 matches the ip-api free tier.
